selector_fallback.why: deterministic, label-free, always in BASE2_298 (as BASE=l(s)), defined on every admissible input

abstention_fallback.why: needs no model output at all

out_of_distribution_fallback.why: reads at most two scalars whose ranges are fixed by the topology (hub count 0..40, residual cap in {1, 1/3}); it cannot be out of its own domain

what_it_is_not: It is not a safety GUARANTEE. The selector's safety floor is relative to this default, so 'no harm' now means 'no worse than the label-free default'. Against the old hidden-label heuristic it was paired-worse in 0/230 existing episodes (see hidden_vs_label_free_comparison.json). No extra mechanism is added to hide that; the hidden heuristic stays in closed-loop evaluation as a reference arm so the gap stays visible.
